description: This Java class serves as a command handler for creating interest rate chart slabs within the Fineract system. It is annotated as a Spring Service and uses dependency injection to call the service responsible for the creation logic when processing commands.

classes.name: CreateInterestRateChartSlabCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles commands to create interest rate chart slabs, delegating the core creation logic to the associated service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JSON command to create a new interest rate chart slab by invoking the write platform service's create method.
